client.name: Pinewood Coworking
client.about: Pinewood Coworking rents desks and meeting rooms on two floors of an old mill. Its front desk runs on notes: who is expected, what is broken, what the next shift must know. Smoke Desk keeps those notes, and an audit service keeps the history of every change.
client.contacts: Nora Bell (front desk lead) and Sam Ortiz (IT contractor) report the tickets.

project.name: Smoke Desk
project.about: The notes of a front desk, with the history of every change. Two services talk over HTTP: the API keeps the notes in PostgreSQL and tells the audit service, which keeps the history in MySQL.
project.stack: React, Vite and CSS Modules; Node.js and Express, in two services; PostgreSQL and MySQL

welcome.subject: Welcome to the Smoke Desk project!
welcome.body:
Hi, and welcome aboard!

I'm Rafaela, the engineering manager here. You're joining **Smoke Desk**, the notes of the front desk of **Pinewood Coworking**. It is small: two tickets, one for each track.

Here's how we work:

- Your tickets show up on the **Board**. Drag one to **In Progress** when you start, and to **In QA** when you think it's done.
- **Open in VS Code** attaches your editor to your workspace. Run `npm run dev` in the VS Code terminal: it starts the client, the API and the audit service. **Open app in browser** opens the desk; the Dashboard shows the port each service got.
- This project has two databases next to your workspace: a **PostgreSQL** for the notes and a **MySQL** for the history. `npm run db:reset` puts the samples back in both.
- QA runs the project tests first, then checks the ticket itself.
- Stuck? Message **Priya** from the ticket, one hint at a time.

When you're ready, click **Get next assignment**.

Rafaela

front-1.subject: New ticket: SD-101
front-1.body:
Sam says the Activity panel is empty on his computer, and Nora says it works on hers.

Check where the panel looks for the audit service.

back-1.subject: New ticket: SD-201
back-1.body:
A note disappeared and the history has no trace of it. Nora wants to know who deletes what.

Check what the API tells the audit service.

completion.subject: Smoke Desk: project complete!
completion.body:
You finished the whole {{track}} track of Smoke Desk, so this project is done on your side. Nora and Sam say thanks.

You can take the other track whenever you like.

Rafaela
